title: Detailed train
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Rails -->
  <rect x='4' y='82' width='92' height='5' rx='2' fill='#7a8a99'/>
  <rect x='4' y='87' width='92' height='3' rx='1' fill='#5a6a79'/>
  <!-- Sleepers -->
  <rect x='10' y='84' width='3' height='8' rx='1' fill='#9b7b5a'/>
  <rect x='24' y='84' width='3' height='8' rx='1' fill='#9b7b5a'/>
  <rect x='38' y='84' width='3' height='8' rx='1' fill='#9b7b5a'/>
  <rect x='52' y='84' width='3' height='8' rx='1' fill='#9b7b5a'/>
  <rect x='66' y='84' width='3' height='8' rx='1' fill='#9b7b5a'/>
  <rect x='80' y='84' width='3' height='8' rx='1' fill='#9b7b5a'/>

  <rect x='10' y='48' width='52' height='30' rx='4' fill='#d63a3a'/>
  <rect x='10' y='48' width='52' height='6' rx='3' fill='#ee5555'/>

  <rect x='14' y='54' width='44' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b02a2a'/>

  <rect x='52' y='36' width='26' height='42' rx='4' fill='#e84848'/>
  <rect x='52' y='36' width='26' height='7' rx='3' fill='#ff6666'/>

  <rect x='57' y='44' width='16' height='14' rx='2' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <rect x='57' y='44' width='16' height='5' rx='2' fill='#fff4cc'/>

  <rect x='56' y='62' width='18' height='12' rx='2' fill='#c93434'/>

  <!-- Roof -->
  <rect x='48' y='30' width='34' height='8' rx='3' fill='#4a6fa5'/>
  <rect x='48' y='30' width='34' height='3' rx='2' fill='#6a8fc5'/>

  <!-- Chimney -->
  <rect x='18' y='32' width='10' height='16' rx='2' fill='#3a4a5a'/>
  <rect x='15' y='28' width='16' height='7' rx='3' fill='#4a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='15' y='28' width='16' height='3' rx='2' fill='#6a7a8a'/>

  <circle cx='20' cy='22' r='5' fill='#b8c8d8' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='16' r='4' fill='#c8d8e8' opacity='0.8'/>

  <circle cx='42' cy='7' r='3' fill='#e8f4ff' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Dome -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='48' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#4a6fa5'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='47' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#6a8fc5'/>

  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='52' r='4' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='52' r='2' fill='#fff7cc'/>
  <!-- Light beam -->
  <polygon points='68,50 84,44 84,60 68,54' fill='#fff7cc' opacity='0.25'/>

  <!-- Cowcatcher -->
  <polygon points='10,78 22,68 22,78' fill='#8a9aaa'/>
  <line x1='12' y1='74' x2='20' y2='70' stroke='#aab8c8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='12' y1='77' x2='20' y2='74' stroke='#aab8c8' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Wheels -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='80' r='9' fill='#2a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='80' r='6' fill='#4a6fa5'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='80' r='2.5' fill='#8aabcf'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='74' x2='22' y2='86' stroke='#8aabcf' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='16' y1='80' x2='28' y2='80' stroke='#8aabcf' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <circle cx='42' cy='80' r='9' fill='#2a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='80' r='6' fill='#4a6fa5'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='80' r='2.5' fill='#8aabcf'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='74' x2='42' y2='86' stroke='#8aabcf' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='36' y1='80' x2='48' y2='80' stroke='#8aabcf' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <circle cx='62' cy='80' r='7' fill='#2a3a4a'/>

  <circle cx='62' cy='80' r='2' fill='#8aabcf'/>

  <!-- Connecting rod -->
  <rect x='20' y='78' width='44' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#aab8c8'/>

  <!-- Front bumper -->
  <rect x='6' y='70' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#8a9aaa'/>

  <!-- Steam pipe detail -->
  <rect x='28' y='42' width='3' height='8' rx='1' fill='#b02a2a'/>
</svg>
